concept: Pinned LangChain MongoDB self-query filter translation and typed metadata values
summary: Source-anchored research for Pinned LangChain MongoDB self-query filter translation and typed metadata values. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Inference from the pinned implementation and Python parsing contract: malformed date strings can raise ValueError locally because the conversion helper does not catch parsing exceptions. Missing payload keys instead leave the dictionary unchanged; conversion is not comprehensive metadata validation. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, visit_structured_query returns (structured_query.query, {}) when structured_query.filter is None. When a filter exists, it instead returns that query with {"pre_filter": filter.accept(translator)}. The translator itself adds no limit parameter. (medium confidence)

A March 5, 2024 issue reports an Atlas date operand rejection with langchain_mongodb 0.1.0 despite supplying a Python datetime. That historical server-side report does not establish failure of the pinned translator or prove that its conversion guarantees server acceptance. (low confidence)

At the pinned commit, IN/NIN wrap every non-list comparison.value in a one-element list, mutating the Comparison object before conversion. Existing lists remain lists; a tuple is wrapped rather than expanded. (medium confidence)

At commit d7d6913d1f31a146236154db18d6c222d2df492d, allowed comparators are EQ, NE, GT, GTE, LT, LTE, IN and NIN; their MongoDB spellings are $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in and $nin. Logical operators are limited to AND and OR, mapped to $and and $or. _format_func calls the inherited validator before mapping; NOT is absent. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, visit_operation recursively visits its arguments and emits {"$and": [...]} or {"$or": [...]}. visit_comparison emits {attribute: {mapped_comparator: converted_value}}; nested logical trees retain their grouping. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, {"type":"date","date":"YYYY-MM-DD"} converts through datetime.datetime.strptime(value["date"], "%Y-%m-%d"). Python parsing defaults make the result midnight with no timezone information. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, a dictionary tagged type=datetime with a datetime key has Z replaced by +00:00 before datetime.datetime.fromisoformat. Explicit offsets survive parsing; strings without offsets produce naive datetime objects. The translator does not force every value to UTC. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, list conversion recursively processes elements, including nested lists and typed date/datetime dictionaries. Scalar IN/NIN date dictionaries therefore become lists containing Python datetime values. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, untagged dictionaries, other type tags, and tagged dictionaries missing their date/datetime payload key pass through unchanged. Ordinary dictionaries are not traversed. Strings, numbers, booleans and existing datetime objects receive no general type coercion. (medium confidence)

At the pinned commit, _similarity_search_with_score passes pre_filter to vector_search_stage for explicit vectors and to autoembedding_vector_search_stage for automatic embedding. pipelines.py imports both builders from pymongo_search_utils; the inspected translator does not implement BSON encoding or the downstream builder. (medium confidence)

The stable documentation source rendering lacks the datetime conversion helper and returns comparison.value directly after IN/NIN wrapping. The pinned source includes that helper. Treating the stable rendering as evidence for the pinned date behavior would therefore be incorrect. (medium confidence)
